newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi bourse index eases, market on hold.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi bourse index eases, market on hold.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange (NSE) 20-share index eased 6.75 points to stand at 3469.92 as investors held on to shares, bourse officials said.
Turnover was posted at 24.145 million shillings on 528,865 shares from 21.358 million shillings on 477,826 shares on Friday.
Brokers and bourse officials said Monday's trading was moderate with very little demand.
Prices on key counters eased marginally with Kenya Commercial Bank shedding 2.50 to close at 87.50, while Total Kenya shed 6.50 to close at 87.50.
One broker said demand for Kenya Commercial Bank had not diminished but some investors had backed out to test whether they were hte only ones pushing for the price to reach 90.

Moderate demand for A. Baumann & Co which announced a bonus of one share for every two in January pushed it up to 42 from 33. Standard Chartered Bank edged to 56.50 from 54.50 on a lack of supply amid strong demand.
The market has been rife with speculation on year-end results for financials expected in February. Brokers said the increased demand for Standard bank was hinged on an expected bonus issue.
Kenya Power & Lighting gained a shilling to stand at 91 while Jubilee Insurance eased down to 35.75 from 38.50.
Sasini Tea & Coffee was down to 59.50 from 60 while Brooke Bond closed at 148 from 149.
